name: Saurophaganax
isnote: PBDB places it in Allosauridae, but the Wikipedia lead describes a dubious chimeric genus, possibly a sauropod, citing Danison et al. on chimeras.
sum: Dubious and chimeric genus of large saurischian from the Late Jurassic Morrison Formation of Oklahoma.
